topics.title: Admission Process
topics.response:
Galgotias University admissions use an online application process:

- Register on the admissions portal and select the programme.
- Enter your personal and academic details, upload the required documents, review the form, and submit it.
- Pay the application fee. The verified 2026-27 admission information lists the application fee as Rs. 1,200.
- Complete the programme-specific eligibility and entrance or merit process. For B.Tech, the verified dataset lists GUEE or a valid JEE Main score; MBA admission may use GUMAT or CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT scores.
- Eligible applicants proceed to document verification and programme fee payment.

The exact deadline and programme requirements can change by admission cycle, so the current admission notice remains the authority for dates.

topics.title: Academic Programs and Specializations
topics.response:
Galgotias University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, and PhD programmes across engineering and technology, computer applications, management, law, science, design, agriculture, hospitality, media, pharmacy, and other disciplines.

Verified programme examples include:
- B.Tech programmes, including Computer Science and Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Mechanical Engineering, and other engineering options.
- B.Tech CSE specializations including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Data Science, Cyber Security, and Internet of Things.
- BCA and specialized BCA options, MCA, M.Tech, BBA, MBA, B.Com, BA, law programmes, B.Ed/M.Ed, pharmacy, agriculture, design, hotel management, diploma programmes, and PhD study across more than 30 subjects.

The exact duration, intake, and entry requirements are programme-specific.

topics.title: Fees and Payment Information
topics.response:
The verified fee information shows that charges vary by programme and may include tuition, examination, accidental insurance, and a one-time caution deposit. Examples available in the project data are:

- B.Tech CSE tuition: Rs. 1,64,000 per year.
- B.Tech CSE examination fee: Rs. 20,000 per year, separate from tuition.
- BCA tuition: Rs. 92,000 per year.
- B.Tech CSE tuition plus examination fee: Rs. 1,84,000 per year, before any other applicable charges.

The Rs. 1,200 admission application fee is a separate one-time processing fee. Fees can vary by programme, specialization, admission category, and international-student status. A caution deposit is paid once, while tuition, examination, and accidental-insurance charges are generally annual.

Installments, refund treatment, and the complete programme-wise breakup depend on the applicable fee structure.

topics.title: Eligibility Criteria
topics.response:
Eligibility is programme-specific. The verified requirements include:

- B.Tech: pass Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry/Biology, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, meet the university's programme-specific minimum percentage, and qualify through GUEE or JEE Main.
- MBA: a bachelor's degree plus a valid GUMAT, CAT, MAT, XAT, or CMAT score.
- PhD: a relevant master's degree and PET, unless the applicant has an accepted NET/JRF/SLET/GATE score.
- B.Arch: the relevant Class 12 qualification with Mathematics and NATA-based admission.
- LLM: an LLB from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.
- International and NRI applicants: completed 12 years of schooling for regular programmes.

Minimum marks and subject requirements can differ by programme, so the selected course's eligibility rule should be applied rather than a single university-wide percentage.

topics.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
topics.response:
The verified scholarship information describes four broad categories:

- Merit Scholarship on Admission, based on board or graduation marks and entrance performance. Verified examples include a 100% tuition waiver for eligible board or university toppers, up to a 50% waiver for JEE Main rank holders up to rank 4,000, and up to a 50% waiver for UPSEE rank holders up to rank 100.
- Sports Quota Scholarship: gold or silver medalists at national or state level, and candidates with exemplary performing-arts or literature achievements, may receive up to a 50% tuition waiver.
- Merit-cum-Means Scholarship: assessed case by case for economically weaker or differently-abled students.
- International-student scholarship category.

Additional verified examples include a 20% waiver for eligible CAT/MAT-based MBA applicants and a 10% tuition waiver for eligible B.Tech lateral-entry students with diploma CGPA 6 or above. Scholarships are not automatic: students must apply and provide the required documents. Continuation and exact criteria depend on the programme and current scheme.

topics.title: Hostel and Accommodation
topics.response:

- Common facilities such as Wi-Fi, an attached cafeteria, a gym, and indoor games including table tennis, carom, and chess.

- Common room or recreational facilities and access to wider campus sports facilities.

topics.title: Examinations, Grading, and Results
patterns: how does the cgpa grading system work
topics.response:
Galgotias University uses a relative grading system and a 10-point grade scale. The verified grade descriptions include O (Outstanding, 10), A+ (Excellent, 9), A (Very Good, 8), B+ (Good, 7), B (Above Average, 6), C (Average, 5), P (Pass, 4), and F (Fail, 0), with AB, DE, and WH status codes also used.

Important verified examination rules include:
- At least 75% attendance in each course is required to be eligible for the SEE/ETE.
- For theory courses, CIE and SEE are weighted 50-50, contributing 100 marks each out of 200.
- CGPA is the credit-weighted average of SGPA values across completed semesters. SGPA is calculated from course grade points weighted by course credits.
- Revaluation is available for theory answer booklets, for any number of subjects, with the prescribed fee and within the notified deadline. The stated policy does not give the same guarantee for practical or laboratory examinations.
- Examination results and date sheets are accessed through the authorised university examination or student systems.
